# Sales Funnel Blueprint Skill for Muse

Turns an offer into a concrete, build-ready sales funnel spec: it pins five inputs first (offer + price point, traffic source, audience awareness level, fulfilment type, what already exists), picks one of six funnel shapes — direct offer, tripwire→core, lead magnet→nurture, VSL/long-form, application, store funnel — then specs every page (goal, traffic in, above-the-fold, body sections, proof, objections, fields, exit path, success metric with benchmark targets), builds the price ladder (entry price, one-click upsell, downsell, backend), and lists the instrumentation that must ship before launch. It refuses to design a funnel for a contact form or brochure site, and tells you plainly when the price point and traffic source conflict. Discovered via skills.sh. Honest note: the build step points to the creator's own open-source, self-hosted funnel builder (Autonnel, Apache-2.0) — a disclosed vendor pitch; the spec itself is platform-neutral. Skill Harbor never reviews the code, review it yourself before use. Not verified.
